# #195 - Laddat för lyft

**Feed**: affarsvarlden-analys  
**Published**: 2026-11-10  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Affärsvärlden Analys episode #195 opens with the AI-led sell-off in US tech and a look at Anthropic's IPO prospectus. The hosts focus on its unusual governance: it is a public benefit corporation, the founders control the shareholder meeting through an F-share, and a trust appoints the board majority through a T-share. They then walk through four Swedish analyses, all ending in buy recommendations: WeSports (a serial acquirer of sports retailers and brands, with hidden minority buyout debt but cheap at about 10x 2027 earnings), Heba (a low-risk Stockholm residential landlord at a nearly 60% discount to asset value), Addtech (high multiples but an attractive entry after a de-rating) and Paradox (a turnaround on upcoming game launches). The overall tone is constructive despite volatile markets.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 HEBA-B — Heba | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Low-risk Stockholm residential portfolio at ~60% discount to asset value. Adjusted P/E ~22, implying ~5% annual return.

#### Reasoning

Stated earnings capacity of 1.60 SEK/share is adjusted for ~50m SEK of higher rates (2.9%→3.5%) and ~50m SEK of recurring maintenance capex, leaving under 1 SEK/share. That gives P/E ~22 at 22 SEK. Vacancy risk is near zero and the yield gap is only 0.2pp. Suits investors wanting low risk, housing exposure and ~5% a year. A re-rating towards asset value is optional upside.

#### Sell Triggers

- if interest rates rise well above 3.5%
- if maintenance capex proves larger
- if vacancies rise

> *"Då är det inget fel att äga Heba så att vi ju det blev ett litet köpråd där."*

---

### 🟢 ADDT-B — Addtech | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Multiples have compressed while earnings grew ~30% over two years. Strong grid/energy demand, high ROCE. Buy at ~21x EBITA 2027.

#### Reasoning

Organic growth has been ~1% a year for two years because of weak sawmill customers and tough energy project comparisons. Acquisitions still lifted profit ~30% while the share price stood still, so the multiple de-rated. Management calls grid demand very strong and Svenska kraftnät and Vattenfall are accelerating. A proven record of return on capital justifies the premium multiple.

#### Sell Triggers

- if energy segment demand stalls
- if sawmill weakness spreads
- if return on capital deteriorates
- if organic growth stays near zero into H2

> *"Det blev ett köpråd för Addtech, ja."*

---

### 🟢 PDX — Paradox Interactive | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Turnaround under returning CEO Wester. Low expectations, insider buying, triggers from the Cities: Skylines Lego expansion and the new strategy game Afterworld.

#### Reasoning

Stable long-life games with recurring DLC revenue. The 7% margin is depressed by write-downs (e.g. Bloodlines, ~700m SEK); normalised margin is 30-40%. After failed diversification under the previous CEO, Wester has refocused on the core. Successful launches could rebuild the narrative and lift the multiple. The hosts admit risk: launch flops would point to deeper problems.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the Lego Cities: Skylines expansion flops
- if Afterworld launch disappoints
- if further write-downs occur

> *"Så att vi satte ett köpråd. Vi får se om vi får äta upp det om de här lanseringarna inte alls blir något bra."*
